sections.title: Unicast — One to One
sections.body: Normal everyday traffic: one sender talks to exactly ONE receiver. Browsing a website is unicast.

sections.title: Multicast — One to a Group
sections.body: One sender reaches MANY interested devices at once — like a live stream only subscribers watch. Uses a reserved address range:
points: Only devices that join the group actually process it.

sections.title: Broadcast — One to EVERYONE
sections.body: A shout that all devices in the network must hear. Used by ARP ("who has this IP?") and DHCP requests.
sections.code:
Limited broadcast : 255.255.255.255  (this network)
Directed broadcast: 192.168.1.255    (last addr of subnet)
MAC broadcast     : FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF

sections.title: Side by Side
sections.tip: 💡 Exam tip: routers do NOT forward broadcasts. Multicast addresses always start between 224 and 239.
